summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Newsletter Builder feature. Backend APIs (templates, rank-order, save/retrieve/export builder newsletters) all working correctly. Frontend UI (post picker, section editing, reordering, AI analysis, template management, branded preview) fully functional. Minor issues: no published blogs by default, status endpoint query param issue.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 422 validation error when setting status via query parameter
minor_bugs.impact: Status change endpoint not working as expected
minor_bugs.details: Expected 200, got 422 with error: Field required for query parameter 'status'

data_issues.issue: No published blogs available by default (all blogs are in draft status)
data_issues.impact: Users must toggle 'Show all' to see any posts in the picker
data_issues.workaround: Toggle 'Show all' switch to see draft posts

data_issues.issue: No media items in Media Library
data_issues.impact: Cannot test media swap functionality fully
data_issues.note: This is expected for a fresh account, not a bug

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/newsletter-templates returns default template + user templates
Backend: POST /api/newsletter-templates creates new template with branding fields
Backend: PUT /api/newsletter-templates/{id} updates template successfully
Backend: DELETE /api/newsletter-templates/{id} deletes template
Backend: POST /api/newsletter/rank-order returns readability, appeal, overall scores (0-100) and suggested_order (1-based indices)
Backend: POST /api/content saves builder newsletter (type=newsletter, newsletter.builder=true, sections[])
Backend: GET /api/content/{id} retrieves saved builder newsletter with all sections
Backend: GET /api/export/{id}?format=html exports branded HTML for builder newsletter
Frontend: 'Roll up multiple posts' button navigates to /newsletter/build
Frontend: Post picker lists blogs with default filter (published only)
Frontend: 'Show all' toggle reveals draft posts
Frontend: Search input filters posts by title
Frontend: Add button adds blog as section and disables/checks when added
Frontend: Section subheader, excerpt, and Read More URL are editable
Frontend: Up/down buttons reorder sections correctly
Frontend: Live ranking displays overall score based on heuristic
Frontend: 'Analyze with AI' button returns AI score, rationale, and suggested order
Frontend: 'Apply suggested order' button reorders sections per AI suggestion
Frontend: Template manager opens and allows creating new templates
Frontend: Template selection updates branded preview colors/logo/name
Frontend: Subject and preheader fields are editable
Frontend: Media swap dialog opens from section thumbnail
Frontend: 'Save' button saves newsletter successfully
Frontend: Branded preview displays with correct template styling
